definitions.gloss: performing surgery; operating (as the lead surgeon)
definitions.explanation: The act of performing a surgical operation, specifically as the lead surgeon who wields the scalpel. A formal medical term.

examples.japanese: {名医|めいい}が{執刀|しっとう}した。
examples.english: A renowned doctor performed the surgery.

examples.japanese: {執刀医|しっとうい}は{経験|けいけん}{豊富|ほうふ}な{外科医|げかい}だ。
examples.english: The lead surgeon is an experienced surgeon.

examples.japanese: 12{時間|じかん}にわたる{大手術|だいしゅじゅつ}を{執刀|しっとう}し、{患者|かんじゃ}の{命|いのち}を{救|すく}った。
examples.english: The surgeon performed a 12-hour major operation and saved the patient's life.

notes: Composed of {執|しつ} (carry out, execute) + {刀|とう} (blade, sword — here referring to the surgical scalpel). The term literally means 'to take up the blade.' Common collocations: {執刀|しっとう}する (to perform surgery), {執刀医|しっとうい} (lead surgeon/operating surgeon), {執刀|しっとう}を{担当|たんとう}する (to be in charge of the operation). {執刀医|しっとうい} specifically refers to the lead surgeon who performs the actual cutting, distinct from {助手|じょしゅ} (surgical assistant) and {麻酔科医|ますいかい} (anesthesiologist). Commonly seen in medical dramas and news reports about surgeries.
